text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus's Senior year has finally 
arrived—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
All right, we made it! Ikuno, let's draw 
fortunes! Fortunes!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Turbo, the fortunes aren't going 
anywhere. Let's get in line to offer our 
prayers first.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—Today, I came for Hatsumode along with 
Ikuno Dictus and her friends. I'm acting 
as their chaperone.”

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—Man... But seriously, a lot happened last 
year, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yeah~. Ikuno will run lots of GⅠs, and 
we'll all do our best in our own ways—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
“—Turbo thought Ikuno was amazing, but 
Teio's running was super exciting too!”

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed. Her run in the previous race was 
magnificent as well."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio. Bright and innocent, yet 
possessing immense raw talent, she's an 
Umamusume who has long been in the 
spotlight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Living up to her pre-race hype, she made a 
sensational debut last year and is already 
being hailed as one of the top favorites 
for this year's Classic Year.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
“—Turbo's decided! Turbo's making Teio my 
rival!”

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"And on top of that, absolutely, 
definitely! I'm gonna have a white-hot 
race with Teio!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Good grief. Turbo's really been all "Teio, 
Teio" lately, hasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I could never pull off what you do. Like 
making that girl your rival and all."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Really? But come on, Nature, you were 
staring super intently at Teio's race the 
other day too!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ngh! How did you know—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Isn't Teio your rival too, Nature?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, um... It's not like I saw them as a 
rival or anything, um...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Well, how should I put it, it's sparkly 
and really catches your eye, I guess...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
—Speaking from Ikuno's perspective, do you 
find yourself more intrigued by McQueen 
rather than Teio?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Right? Last year's Kikuka Sho was 
incredible, after all.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—And has Macqueen taken the lead?! 
Macqueen in front! Macqueen in front!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: —WOOOOOAAHHH!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Taking the lead on the slight outside is 
Mejiro Ryan, perhaps?! Is it Mejiro Ryan?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Not yetâ

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: LIKE HELL IT'S OVER!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ngh, she's still pulling ahead—!?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
McQueen takes the lead! It's McQueen, it's 
McQueen!! Of the Mejiros, it's McQueen 
taking it!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Mejiro McQueen claimed a brilliant 
victory, defeating last year's Kikuka Sho 
favorite, Mejiro Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her late burst on the final straight, 
refusing to yield the lead, was 
phenomenal—a glimpse into everything she 
bears and carries on her shoulders...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The way McQueen-san runs, embodying her 
unwavering convictions... It still gives 
me chills.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of McQueen... Is that rumor for 
real?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
That she's running in this year's Osaka 
Haiâ

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...It's true. I heard it directly from 
them not long ago.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Regarding that matter, Ikuno Dictus 
had already briefed me on it."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
――I apologize for calling you out to a 
place like this on short notice.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No. ...I sensed there was a reason you 
chose not to speak in the dorms, but―

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes. That is correct.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What I'm about to tell you now isn't 
coming from me as your roommate—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As an umamusume of Mejiro, as Mejiro 
McQueen, this is what I offer to you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...I, Mejiro McQueen, as an Umamusume of 
the Mejiro family, will challenge the 
Tenno Sho (Spring) in my Senior year."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"As you know, that race is the stage of 
our long-cherished ambition. A 
battleground that takes precedence over 
everything else. And yet—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I have decided to stop using that as an 
excuse to shy away from the "Royal Road."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Don't tell me—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—I shall run in all three races of the 
Senior Spring Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
First is the Osaka Hai. I look forward to 
crossing swords with you there.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"May I take that... as a sort of 
declaration of war?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Please, do not demean yourself. Naturally, 
that is precisely what was meant.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...The time has come for our hoofprints to 
intersect upon the turf.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...I will defeat you, and every other 
Umamusume. As a Mejiro, I will do what 
must be done—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Let us have a fair and square match. 
...Ikuno Dictus-san.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (How dazzling it is.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(Without minding what must be carried, 
taking pride in it, turning it into the 
strength to move forward, and simply 
acting with solemn resolve.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(I hold the way you live your life... in 
the highest respect. Which is exactly 
why—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —I'd like nothing more.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Putting heart and soul on the line, let's 
compete. ...Mejiro McQueen-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufuâ That is so very like you, 
Ikuno-san.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
――Ikuno, the line's starting to move! 
Let's go, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "Oops— Well then, let us be on our way."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after everyone finished their 
shrine visit—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
âWell then, shall we disband for now? 
Thanks for your hard work, Trainer.
choice_data_list: No, no, thank you for inviting me

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous just texted me on LANE, so I'm 
heading straight back to my room. Good 
work today~

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna go eat ozoni with Fuku-chan 
senpai after this~♪ Mochi-mochi-mochi~♪

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo's gonna play spinning tops with 
Inari! Inari's super duper strong!! 
Turbo's gonna wiiin today--!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It seems everyone has plans with their 
roommates. Do you have anything going on 
after this, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That worked out nicely. Since we have the 
chance, shall we go somewhere for fun?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
McQueen-san has business with the Mejiro 
family today, and I am free after this as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The Osaka Hai is coming up soon, too... 
How about catching your breath while you 
still can?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This might indeed be a good opportunity. 
If we're going out to hang out with Ikuno 
Dictus—
choice_data_list: Shall we go grab something to eat for now?
Want to go to a movie or something?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
True, it's almost lunchtime anyway, so the 
timing is perfect.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
......In that case, there is a shop I 
would like to visit.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I'll check if it's 
open today, then.

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waiting~! Here is your slider 
combo!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What was placed on the table was a 
hamburger about two sizes smaller than 
usual.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
With this, even we should be able to eat 
without making a mess.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
By the way, the name "slider" comes from 
the fact that they are so small they 
"slide" right down your throat, 
apparently.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Fufuâ

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Well then, shall we dig in right away?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, while making idle chit-chat with 
Ikuno Dictus, the two of us happily 
enjoyed our sliders—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—May I take that as some sort of 
declaration of war?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Believe it or not, I've been trained by 
Turbo-san. So if we're going to the game 
center—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to be your opponent with all my 
might.
choice_data_list: ...Then show me what you're capable of!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, cutting through the wind with 
Ikuno Dictus, we headed toward the game 
center—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "GYAAOOOOOOON!!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Reload the rocket launcher while 
you still have the chance!
choice_data_list: Got it! Hold out for 5 seconds!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I'll throw in an extra 3 
seconds as a courtesy.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Now then, it's party time.
choice_data_list: (Where did she pick up that attitude...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I ended up casually enjoying co-op games 
at the arcade with a super enthusiastic 
Ikuno Dictus.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good. Is there a movie you'd like 
to see, Trainer?
choice_data_list:
I was thinking of deciding once I get to 
the theater.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That once-in-a-lifetime charm sounds quite 
fascinating too. Shall we head over right 
away?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, Ikuno Dictus and I headed to the 
nearest movie theater and watched a film 
that happened to be showing, but—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. You say that, Trainer, but your 
eyes are getting all teary too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The movie I watched with Ikuno Dictus was 
about a certain Umamusume whose spirit was 
crushed after an injury left her unable to 
run, and—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It is a story of friendship and a 
miraculous comeback for a human girl who, 
likewise, was unable to play her favorite 
sport due to an injury—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In many parts, as someone involved in 
sports myself, I found myself deeply 
sympathizing with the movie's themes...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—The scene where the two, who clashed at 
first, vow to understand and help each 
other and exchange friendship bracelets 
was really memorable.
choice_data_list:
I know. The rehab scene after that was 
great too.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Sharing the hardship, encouraging one 
another, and celebrating each step 
forward..."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Even if you're far apart, just knowing 
someone is walking toward the same goal... 
naturally gives you strength...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It was an exquisitely beautiful scene, 
conveyed through visuals rather than 
words.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Oh right, and another thing we can't 
forget is the rain scene near the end—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, like that, we spent the rest of 
the day discussing the movie's plot.
